svg.title: Night Reco pulse (mean of days 0 to 2) against the soil water content anomaly before the rain, one marker per 5 mm event.
svg.desc: Six panels, one per site. X axis: soil water content (SWC) of the day before the rain minus the site median of the season, in m3 m-3. Y axis: pulse = mean of days 0 to 2 of night Reco relative to the temperature model, relative to the pre-pulse mean. One marker per event with at least 5 mm of rain; line = ordinary least squares (OLS) fit. Per site: Anttila: n = 2, too few events for a fit. Särkisuo: n = 1, too few events for a fit. Haltiala (Viikki rain): Pearson r = −0.29 (p = 0.573), Spearman ρ = −0.31 (p = 0.544), slope −0.6 (ratio) per m3 m-3, n = 6. Qvidja: Pearson r = −0.46 (p = 0.545), Spearman ρ = 0.20 (p = 0.800), slope −3.4 (ratio) per m3 m-3, n = 4. Viikki: n = 2, too few events for a fit. Maktau: Pearson r = −0.37 (p = 0.064), Spearman ρ = −0.60 (p = 0.001), slope −2.0 (ratio) per m3 m-3, n = 26.
